stem: Based on the story, what can the reader conclude about homestead laws in the early 1900s?

options.label: A
options.text: Women could not file a homestead claim.

options.label: B
options.text: Homestead laws favored men over women.

options.label: C
options.text: Homestead claims could not be passed from one family member to another.

options.label: D
options.text: Land officials had some freedom in interpreting homestead laws.
